title: Impacts of land system change− driven urban heat islands on surface water dynamics and moisture conditions in Gauteng Province, South Africa

primary.rationale: Deterministic query-to-theme assignment for owner calibration; not an AI judgement.

short_summary: Abstract Surface water is a scarce resource in Gauteng, South Africa. This study analysed the impacts of urban heat islands on surface water dynamics and moisture conditions from 1984 to 2024 using vegetation and water indices in the Google Earth Engine. The results indicate that Gauteng has experienced a slight increase in land surface temperature (LST), ranging from 62°C to 63.2°C, and low LST decreased from 24.8°C to 10.32°C.
